name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum. Adds terms for AI features in a product: use of AI inputs and outputs, model training limits, and related duties.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA). Covers how a provider may use and protect PHI under HIPAA.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) standard terms. For selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA). Sets controller, processor and subprocessor duties for personal data under GDPR-style privacy laws.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement. Gives an early partner access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Mutual NDA (MNDA) standard terms. Lets both parties share confidential information and keep it protected.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA. Holds the deal-specific terms (purpose, dates, governing law) and signatures, and incorporates the MNDA standard terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement. For business partnerships between two companies, with each party's obligations set on the Cover Page.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement. Lets a customer try a product for a limited pilot period before buying.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA). For services and deliverables delivered under statements of work (SOWs).

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA). Adds uptime targets, support response times and service credits to the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement. For licensing software that the customer installs and runs itself.
